openItems.item: China registration gate for a Rwandan green-coffee exporter
openItems.detail: From 20 Jul 2026 China runs a single continent-wide approval regime for qualified coffee beans from all 53 African countries. That is NOT the same as the overseas-establishment registration/certification a specific Rwandan exporter must hold to clear customs. Do not assume one implies the other.

openItems.status: FOUND — and two dates are being conflated
openItems.detail: Zero tariff for all 53 African countries from 1 May 2026 (that is the TARIFF). 20 Jul 2026 is the unified PHYTOsanitary approval regime (that is not a tariff date). A Rwandan LDC origin has no expiry; the 30 Apr 2028 window belongs to the 20 non-LDC African countries.
